title: Mattermost bridge (webhook)
description: Brings Mattermost messages to your agents the moment they are posted (an outgoing webhook) and posts replies back as a bot account. A bridge described entirely as data: the generic webhook checks Mattermost's token and reads its fields by path.
setup_notes: Mattermost must be able to reach this oddjob's address. In Mattermost: under Integrations > Bot Accounts, add a bot and copy its access token, then add the bot to the channel. Under Integrations > Outgoing Webhooks, add one with Content Type application/json, the channel (or trigger words), and the Callback URL https://<this oddjob's address>/bridges/api/webhook/<connector name>; save it and copy the Token it shows. Everything lands as a draft: enable the credential under API Credentials, approve the connector under Connectors, then bind the conversation to an agent in Bridges.

questions.name: name
questions.label: Connector name
questions.help: Letters, digits and underscores; it is the last part of the Callback URL.

questions.name: bot_username
questions.label: Bot's username
questions.help: Its own posts are skipped, so it never answers itself.

questions.name: bot_token
questions.label: Bot access token
questions.help: From Integrations > Bot Accounts. Stored in the credential's secret store.

questions.name: webhook_token
questions.label: Outgoing webhook token
questions.help: The Token Mattermost shows for the outgoing webhook. Every push is checked against it.
